title: Allow os.path in the workflow sandbox on Python 3.13.12+

files.patch:
@@ -643,16 +643,17 @@ def _public_callables(parent: Any, *, exclude: set[str] = set()) -> set[str]:
         "os": SandboxMatcher(
             # As of https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/132662 in python 3.14 we have to allow os.path calls
             # which may occur during exception tracing. See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/140228.
+            # The linecache change behind it was backported to python 3.13.12.
             children={
                 "path": SandboxMatcher.none
-                if sys.version_info >= (3, 14)
+                if sys.version_info >= (3, 13, 12)
                 else SandboxMatcher.all
             },
             access={"name"},
             use={"*"},
             # As of https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/112097, os.stat
             # calls are now made when displaying errors
-            exclude={"stat", "path"} if sys.version_info >= (3, 14) else {"stat"},
+            exclude={"stat", "path"} if sys.version_info >= (3, 13, 12) else {"stat"},
             # Only restricted at runtime
             only_runtime=True,
         ),

     # Unfortunately, we can't intercept the type() call
     assert type(obj.foo) is _RestrictedProxy
+
+
+def test_os_path_is_allowed_where_traceback_formatting_needs_it():
+    # Formatting a traceback calls os.path (via linecache) from inside the
+    # sandbox on Python 3.14+ and on 3.13.12+, where the linecache rewrite
+    # (https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/133253) was backported. See
+    # https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/140228.
+    context = RestrictionContext()
+    context.is_runtime = True
+    matcher = SandboxRestrictions.invalid_module_members_default
+    restricted = matcher.match_access(context, "os", "path", "isabs", include_use=True)
+    assert restricted == (sys.version_info < (3, 13, 12))
